response: Saved Views is available today for every team on a paid plan. Organizing and returning to your most important filters, sorts, and layouts just got easier: instead of rebuilding the same view every time you open a project, you can now save it once and come back to it whenever you need it. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to set up dashboards for different projects, sprints, clients, or workflows without cluttering your workspace. Views aren't limited to personal use, either — you can share any saved view with your team, so everyone works from the same setup and stays aligned on priorities without repeating manual steps. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific sprint, or keeping an eye on a client's progress, Saved Views helps your whole team find what matters faster. This feature is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
